test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from the options that can replace the question mark (?) and complete the given pattern.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/324df8073c6f4c06a1a875941858e91fa07fcd3db7d67f76a2cf42e32068a30a.png]
solution:
The logic followed in the given figure series is:

**From Figure (1) to (2):**

The symbol move as shown below and the symbol (=) changes into a new symbol star.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d57164fd65cf2f8b4196b33c0219be3822176aae07188d3e41af44a1d08d4f45.png] 

**From Figure (2) to (3):**

The symbol move as shown below and the symbol star changes into a new symbol F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a095fba11f87553539c1399d1e49a196c64bdf859062667aa7edeafa25e90bc.png] 

**From Figure (3) to (4):**

The symbol move as shown below and the symbol F changes into a new symbol 9.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3163cd8962faa3b997a0c1b4bb56ff87df0af3366ba12c6570ffc91baa10b613.png] 

**From Figure (4) to Answer Figure (5):**

The symbol move as shown below and the symbol 9 changes into a new symbol triangle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/369478bb25d21c9d398259d62c7e91d81cf2f2b9a59e09d6c2ba2acc5c022fae.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
